stem: Which image record gives the reviewer the strongest evidence for a color-related leaf observation?
choices: A whole-plant context image plus a clear close image, both linked to plant/location identity and observation time
A sharp close image linked to plant ID and time, but with no whole-plant or area context
A whole-plant context image linked to identity and time, but no detailed image of the observed leaf feature
A context and close image after manual color adjustment to match how the technician remembers the plant appearing
rationale: The strongest set preserves both context and detail, links the images to identity and time, and avoids appearance-changing edits. A close-up alone or a context view alone leaves important interpretive information missing.

extensions.sourceScope: Transferable diagnostic-photo and context guidance; not cannabis-specific.
